title: AUSSIE SOVEREIGN CITIZENS. Part 1.
summary: Australian commentary on local sovereign citizens: US/Canadian roots, Posse Comitatus history, kit sellers, pandemic growth, court failures and the control psychology of adherents.

verdicts.note: A motivational interpretation; researchers propose several drivers and it is not directly measurable.
Adherents show a sense of superiority from secret knowledge and alienation, but the review also cites greed (Detaxers) and paranoid political belief; no measurement of motive.
Pseudolaw lets adherents disregard legal norms and disempower state actors while still seeing themselves as lawful, which fits a control motive but is not measured.

Authors suggest the findings fit the hypothesis that the movement is about the (re)acquisition of power by those who feel powerless and about managing status anxiety; descriptive data only, causality unclear.
